protocol: Prospective fixed comparison. Train only on the exact old 384 Slavic cases and 288 old-language training cases; change replay allocation 96/96/96 to 64/64/160 with the same hash order, four epochs, all previous optimizer settings and two shuffle seeds. Compare pre-adaptation, two immutable historical rehearsal checkpoints, two new priority-replay checkpoints, and their fixed 0.75 adapted + 0.25 reference weight interpolations. All seven conditions score all 663 old cases plus 128 evaluation-only official test cases each from Ukrainian IU, English EWT, Japanese GSD and Chinese GSDSimp. Exclude normalized duplicates and exact prior-source overlaps before length/caps; never train or select a model/ratio/checkpoint using fresh corpora. The fixed mixed candidate must preserve old Ukrainian non-whitespace micro F1 >=0.97, fresh Ukrainian within 0.005 of historical rehearsal, fresh Chinese at least historical rehearsal, and all fresh/historical EN/JA/ZH full macro F1 within declared tolerances of pre-adaptation. Report every failed gate and negative result without retries or retuning. Unknown Chinese source document IDs and sentence-like Japanese provider units preclude document confidence intervals there. Other intervals are conditional on supplied units and fixed pretrained initialization. No language-oracle routing or inference ensemble. No fluency, general retention, calibrated correctness or production claim. Raw text, predictions and checkpoint weights remain local; Ukrainian IU noncommercial evaluation data never trains candidates.
